column2: [4] Cave Cleaning

The Mobile Infantry continues its mission of clearing bug hives and mining tunnels around the settlements of Kwalasha.

Several squads have not returned from one of the larger mines, prompting Hawthorne's battle-hardened troopers to investigate the scene.

So, tell me about this deathtrap you’ve sent us into.  Any word from the advance squads?
We don’t know the situation underground. It’s safe to assume that bugs still control the mine tunnels.
Roger that. All right troopers, let’s go on a bug hunt! I want every inch of these mines cleared!
These doors are locked. Must have been trying to stop the bugs
You'll need to get to the control room to get them open.
Control Room is back online. Remotely accessing door locks...
Goddamnit. All friendly units down. Mission failed.
Tanker bug! Keep your distance from that thing!
Tanker's down! Regroup and move up.
Looks like it’s wounded. We can take this thing down with grenades.
Big chamber up ahead. Looks like the bugs enlarged it to make room for something.
Heads up. Security cameras reveal bugs on the way!
Bugs are down.  What you got for us next, Cortez?
Colonel, cameras are picking up a group of survivors trapped further down the mine.
Alright, let's go rescue these boys and girls.
Fine job on the rescue Colonel.  But we're detecting multiple bug contacts beyond that door.
Alright, roger that.  You new guys, lock and load.  We're gonna kill some bugs.
Congrats troopers, two tankers down in one day! When we get back topside, feel free to push those bragging rights.
Watch out, another Tanker!
There’s one of the advance teams. Troopers, you’re coming with us.
More of our guys! Glad we ran into them.
We have to take out that nest before continuing.
I hear movement, and it ain’t coming on two legs. Defensive formation! Maintain a clear field of fire.
That’s it for now. Move up.
Damnid, the corridor is blocked. No other choice but to go through this tunnel and see if we can find another route.
Finally out of Archie's caves... This should position us on the far end of the Control Room.
We’re on bug home turf, so be ready for the worst.
